lead.headline: Zay Flowers holds the top of the standings
lead.dek: Bad things man bad things is finished at 172.72. Maye I touch your TDs? has 161.08 and one receiver left. If Flowers clears 11.64, the 2-7 team takes down a 7-2 team tonight.
lead.pull: Three R.A.T.S. matchups are all but final. The fourth comes down to one Ravens receiver, projected 16.24, needing 11.65.
body: Thirteen NFL games are final. One is left, Chargers at Ravens at 5:15 PM, and five R.A.T.S. starters are in it. Three of the week’s four matchups are as good as done. This one isn’t. Bad things man bad things has 172.72 and nobody left. Maye I touch your TDs? has 161.08 and Zay Flowers. He needs more than 11.64 to win it. He’s projected for 16.24, and the board makes Maye a 69.3% team.

Here are the stakes, and they’re bigger for the team that’s already done playing. Bad things man bad things came in 7-2, level with Poochinski and AB81. Poochinski is 99.2% to win with nobody left to play. AB81 is losing to Santa Clara’s Finest by 101.9. So Flowers decides whether Bad things takes its eighth win and stays level with Poochinski, or falls a game behind it. A 2-7 team is holding the tiebreaker sheet hostage.

Maye got here without its namesake. Drake Maye scored 3.02 against a 23.29 projection, and Sleeper now lists him Out with an ankle. Brock Purdy carried the quarterback room with 31.66, Amon-Ra St. Brown added 25.8, and Emmett Johnson, the Saturday-morning waiver add, put up 35.1 against a 16.74 projection. That’s a lineup that scored like a contender and is 2-7 anyway.

If Bad things loses, look at its bench before you look at Flowers. Kirk Cousins scored 16.38 on it while Tyler Shough started and scored 10.98. Josh Downs scored 15.3 on it while Tetairoa McMillan started and scored 6.5. Those two swaps add up to more than tonight’s margin. Chuba Hubbard’s 34.2 and the Rams D/ST’s 17.0 built the lead; the bench is what kept it from being out of reach.

My pick: Maye I touch your TDs?. A receiver projected 16.24 needs 11.65, in a game where four other R.A.T.S. starters are also playing. One catch-and-run either way and this is a different standings page Tuesday.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins played Sunday with a bye at RB
quick_hits.body: D’Andre Swift’s bye stayed in deeboliciouskins’ RB slot all weekend, and Tony Pollard scored 23.9 on the bench. It cost nothing: deeboliciouskins beat Big Stric Energy 178.08 to 123.24 behind George Pickens’ 43.5 and Patrick Mahomes’ 35.42. Next time the margin won’t be 54.84.

quick_hits.headline: It needs 24.25 from the Ravens defense
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom sits at 168.2 against Poochinski’s 192.44 with only the Ravens D/ST (8.34) left. The board says 0.8%. The joke is who that defense is playing: Justin Herbert, AB81’s quarterback. Cherry Blossom needs Herbert to have the worst night of his life, and AB81 needs him to have a great one for nothing.

quick_hits.headline: 192.44, the best score of Week 10
quick_hits.body: Jahmyr Gibbs scored 44.2, Dak Prescott 35.42, Chase Brown 28.3. Poochinski is done, 99.2% to win, and owns the week’s high score by 1.58 over the Finest. Quinshon Judkins’ 16.1 on the bench is a rounding error now.

quick_hits.headline: Down 101.9, with 36.41 left to play
quick_hits.body: Herbert, Derrick Henry and Mark Andrews are projected for 36.41 combined. AB81 trails Santa Clara’s Finest 190.86 to 88.96. The 7-2 team takes its third loss tonight, and the 2-7 Finest gets Joe Burrow’s 33.16 and Isaiah Likely’s 27.7 in the win column.

quick_hits.headline: Bowers is Out, Kelce questionable: Cherry Blossom’s TE problem
quick_hits.body: Sleeper now lists Brock Bowers Out with an ankle and Travis Kelce Questionable with an ankle. Bowers scored 3.8 in the flex Sunday; Kelce 5.0 at tight end. Maye I touch your TDs? has its own Monday headache: Drake Maye Out, A.J. Brown Out, and no quarterback on the bench in a two-QB league.

quick_hits.body: The model gives Maye I touch your TDs? 70.4% playoff odds at 2-7, Big Stric Energy 25.9% and Santa Clara’s Finest 5.6%. Tonight’s Flowers game moves the one that’s still contested.
